phase: Frozen-only final evaluation after recovery stages 1-4
training_policy: A: reuse six successful original-model training runs; original structures and recipes disclosed; no training in this stage
parent_gate: control_init_witness_20261025 queue_done with complete B0 baseline fields and corrected control groups; real wrapper exit0; locks removed; actual owned processes exited
public_source_review: PSP/DeepLab/Fast/OCR exact hash equality; precise known PP-LiteSeg hash pair has reviewed 1x1 expand + value-identical clone compatibility exception; any other mismatch stops
candidate_gate: At most two parent-val-frozen candidates. Require both mean_accuracy_gate and at_least_two_iou_within_tolerance. If none pass, A0 is final reference; failed candidates remain validation-only negatives.
primary_pretest_policy: Eligible preregistered lightweight_balance track first; otherwise eligible secondary; otherwise A0. Freeze before unified validation/test and never choose by test.
validation_policy: Same new backend val for six public, A0 seeds42/43/44, and all eligible candidate seeds42/43/44. Record CM differences when historical CM exists. Recompute candidate matched-A0 mean/two-seed gates; any changed decision stops before test.
test_gate: Only after unified validation decision remains unchanged; separate test_authorization linked by SHA to final manifest and val gate. No test data for selecting or replacing candidates.
evaluation: Official infer.inference with original trans_info and align_corners; strict full checkpoint keys and shapes; original image coordinates; binary0/1 labels; globalCM
boundary: 3x3 inner foreground boundary; cv2 BORDER_CONSTANT=0; cv2 DIST_L2 DIST_MASK_PRECISE; symmetric <=2px+1e-6; aggregate counts then harmonic mean; explicit empty cases
config_changes: Only Windows-to-WSL dataset paths and pretrained:null to avoid unused initialization downloads before strict full-state load. Model type, feature width, auxiliary heads and alignment settings unchanged.
baseline_initialization_witness: Formal B0 seed42 is replaced by the isolated additional control with verified common local ImageNet binary SHA. Old B0 seed42 remains historical. Candidate eligibility remains matched against A0; no reselection using B0 witness or test.
training_recipe_disclosure: Shared18k/seed42/batch4/AdamW6e-5/end_lr0/augmentation/split. Init/loss/EMA differ; this is not a strict common training recipe or an official-paper-optimized recipe claim.
L01: retained as independent loss alternative; no fusion combination or test selection here
profiling: Optional separate interfaces: same-process FP32 batch1 interleaved random order,8x100 after50warmup at400/480; fresh-process allocated and reserved peaks; nvidia-smi process/clock/power/thermal telemetry. FLOPs unmeasured if complete op support cannot be verified; grid_sample cannot be silently omitted.
repeat_policy: No duplicate successful stages. Failed/partial stage logs and receipts are immutable; rerun requires new isolated attempt, not truncation or concatenation.
